canonical_scripts.role: Canonical time classifier g_t (SDR-001). Single shared implementation; imported by every analysis script.

key_constants.rule: SAFE iff sunrise(date) <= t < sunset(date); UNSAFE otherwise; UNSAFE on bottom

canonical_scripts.relationship_to_manuscript: Supplies the time component of the state classifier; determines the non-daylight UNSAFE policy.

canonical_scripts.role: PRIMARY entry point for the headline experiment: classifier, the four governance mappings, pairwise admissible-set divergence, and the departure-window filter.

key_constants.divergence_rule: set inequality (x != y) over per-hour frozensets

canonical_scripts.relationship_to_manuscript: Produces C0<->C1, C0<->C2, Delta_L2, C1<->C3 and the state distributions for both configurations.

solar_artifact.relationship_to_daylight_classification: canonical_gt.py consumes sunrise_hours and sunset_hours (float, 6 dp) and never the HH:MM:SS display columns. g_t returns SAFE iff sunrise <= t < sunset.

environmental.source_of_values: scripts/condition_comparison.py (lines 63, 72, 76, 213) — read from code, not from reports

departure_window.basis: evaluation-policy choice, not an observed departure period

wind.basis: MET Malaysia Cat 1 / Cat 2 onsets (40 and 50 km/h), preserved unrounded

rainfall.basis: DID Infobanjir light-category upper limit; MET thunderstorm trigger

ocean_state_small_vessel.operators: UNSAFE iff wave > O_U (strict); CAUTION iff O_C <= wave <= O_U (inclusive)

non_daylight_policy.source_note: COLREGs Rule 20(b) supplies the sunset-to-sunrise boundary for navigation lights only; no source establishes the AI-withdrawal policy.

marine_warning.handling: held at SAFE throughout (declared exclusion D = {m})
marine_warning.reason: no usable historical archive for the replay period

environmental.aggregation: maximum severity over the five component classifications; UNSAFE is the maximal element

C1.description: participation gated; scope never restricted while active

C3.description: three-state topology; identical to C1 by construction

participation_gate_G.definition: G(S) = 0 if S = UNSAFE; 1 if S in {SAFE, CAUTION}
participation_gate_G.note: G is defined on the STATE. It is not computed anywhere in the metric path; no canonical script references it.

admissible_set_A_AI.definition: A_AI(SAFE) = R; A_AI(CAUTION) = {Go, Delay}; A_AI(UNSAFE) = empty
admissible_set_A_AI.strict_containment: A_AI(UNSAFE) strictly-subset A_AI(CAUTION) strictly-subset A_AI(SAFE) (Corollary C.2, Strict Monotonicity)

pairwise_disagreement_metric.implemented_rule: proportion of evaluated hours on which two configurations admit DIFFERENT sets (set inequality, condition_comparison.py line 198)
pairwise_disagreement_metric.manuscript_wording: 'the number of those hours in which one configuration admits a strictly smaller set than another'
pairwise_disagreement_metric.inconsistency_note: NOT SILENTLY RESOLVED. The implemented rule is set inequality; the manuscript states a directional strict-subset rule. The two coincide for all four configurations because every admissible set is a subset of R, but they are not the same definition.

delta_l2.derived_identity: Delta_L2 = P(S = CAUTION) for the evaluated mappings
delta_l2.secondary_implementation: threshold_sensitivity.py lines 60-66 computes Delta_L2 independently from the admissible-set tables and asserts the identity holds

wave_OC_OU_sweep.tag: Yaakob big vessel / MET Cat1 ceiling

alternative_wave_unsafe_boundary.note: 1.90 is 1.875 rounded; the rounding is declared in threshold_comparison.py line 36.

denominator_alternatives.T1: daylight-only DENOMINATOR: evaluation set restricted to departure-window AND daylight hours; CANON is unchanged and g_t still runs

limitations: INTERNAL reproducibility is strong: all canonical scripts and all four input datasets are tracked in git, the pipeline is deterministic, and the headline-chain code is byte-identical to the revision that produced the archived results.

EXTERNAL reproducibility is NOT established: repository visibility is unverified, there is no dependency specification in the repository, and no execution order is documented outside this manifest and its companion guide.

Re-collecting the raw data from Open-Meteo will NOT reproduce the original bytes. The archive is live and unversioned, and no retrieval timestamp or checksum was recorded at collection time. Reproduction must use the committed CSVs.
Seven of the manuscript's reported results (grades C and E) have no preserved machine output. They are UNVERIFIED, not shown to be wrong.
